Second we intend to beat our own VETS World best times for distances up to 25 miles and will be running the Vets between 12 and 2.30 p.m. Make sure you contact Bill Laws [phone number withheld] or in the case of Vets, Bob Kersey [phone number withheld].

At present it is not clear how strong we will be - Pat O'Connor and Keith Sinclair are injured. Lional Maun and Laurie O'Hara are both going well and Bill Laws and Bob Kersey are back in training, so it could be interesting.
